name: Coop Sapporo Future Forest Creation Fund Forest Group Grant

funder.name: Coop Sapporo (コープ未来の森づくり基金)

summary: Grants for groups doing forest-creation work in Hokkaido: tree planting, forest care and use of forest products. Small grants support group running costs; large grants fund activities for up to three years, including chainsaws and other direct forestry equipment.

amount.note: Small grants up to JPY 100,000; large grants JPY 300,000 to 1,000,000

reporting: Final results report within one month of the project ending; multi-year large grants may need an interim report

eligibility.rule: Organisation active in Hokkaido; companies and universities only for their nonprofit activities
Have operating rules, a representative and a fixed address
Has at least 1 year of activity history
Not research top-ups, class activities, government services, for-profit, political, religious or mostly outsourced work

documents: Small grants: operating rules, address and representative
Small grants: record of past activities
Small grants: future activity plan with site map
Large grants: 2026 work plan and budget
Large grants: articles of association or equivalent, except companies and universities
Large grants: decision-making body roster, except companies and universities
Large grants: 3 years of financial statements, except companies and universities

eligibility.quote: 北海道内を活動エリアとする団体（民間企業・大学の非営利活動を含む）
運営規約、代表者および所在地が定まっていること
活動実績が1年以上であること
研究機関における研究費の補填、教育機関による授業の一環としての活動費 ● 行政などが行う住民サービス、行政からの申請 ● 営利事業や政治的宗教的活動 ● 委託部分が多く、申込団体が主たる実施団体と認められない活動
